There's a rare kind of smart no report card will ever test: reading a room. 📡

Isaac walks into the kitchen and in two seconds he knows exactly how everyone is feeling. People call him "anxious." But that radar isn't broken. 🧠❤️ It's a stress-adapted skill, and it's often a gift.

The catch? His radar keeps scanning even on sunny days. ☀️ Always on the lookout for the next storm.

So his mom didn't try to switch it off. She taught him one simple question to ask himself: "Is there a storm right NOW?" ⛈️

A door slams. His radar goes off. Then he whispers his question… and goes back to building his tower. 🧱

"And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm." Mark 4:39

The disciples panicked in the storm, but Jesus was right there in the boat. One word, and even the wind obeyed. 🙏 Your child's radar can learn to rest too. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
